title: This is horrible
author: EggIll838
selftext: As someone who is planning out a game, all you are doing is cheating the process of making games.

comments.author: stuffedcrust_studios
comments.body: Wow well done on 'planning out a game'

replies.author: EggIll838
replies.body: At least I’ll actually make a game.

replies.author: GigaTerra
replies.body:
No. You have to understand that even before AI 80% of all developer who try to make games never succeed in finishing one. Half of those who make a game publish it. Very-very few people ever make a game. The people who plan and design but never actually learn how to code and make art are the ones who often fail first.

This is the real world, there is no cheating as there is no judges or rules for what can be a game.

comments.author: Momkiller781
comments.body: Who is? I'm sorry, I don't understand what is so horrible. Would you please explain yourself?

comments.author: throwaway_pls123123
comments.body:
What? Cheating implies having an unfair advantage, AI is useable by anyone, its a matter of choice to use it or not.

It is more unfair if you have a good computer or people around you who can help you compared to other people, AI is more accessible.

replies.author: EggIll838
replies.body: But why should I use AI?

replies.author: throwaway_pls123123
replies.body:
There is no "should", its personal choice, you either use it or don't.

Similar to how you may use Unity or Unreal Engine, there is no "should" in either one, its a matter of choice.

replies.author: Momkiller781
replies.body: No one is telling you to do it. You are here judging us for using it. Why? If you are bored, then go actually make a game as you said.

comments.author: aigamedev-ModTeam
comments.body: Be respectful. Removed for AI Art or Artist bashing.

comments.author: SoMuchMango
comments.body:
u/EggIll838  "As someone who is planning out a game"

Keep planning. It's not a part of r/aigamedev scope.

You'll get back here asking for help if you start making your game for real.

comments.author: Momkiller781
comments.body: So yeah... Basically trolling. Go away
